mapper.select: SELECT msg_no, room_no, sender_email, msg_type, content, request_no, request_status, reg_time FROM tbl_babysitter_chat_message WHERE room_no = #{roomNo} ORDER BY reg_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_chat_message (room_no, sender_email, msg_type, content, request_no, request_status) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{senderEmail}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{requestNo}, #{requestStatus})
